title: Otwin conformance result
description: What an adapter writes to stdout. It reports NUMBERS ONLY and never judges itself: all judgement happens in otwin-spec, so a bug in one language's checking code cannot hide a bug in that language's models.

unsupported.description: Fixture ids this implementation declares out of scope. A declared gap does not block conformance; a wrong answer does.

state.description: (n_steps, n_states) or a list of sample states

additionalProperties.description: A list of (n x n) matrices, one per evaluated state. MUST be nested row-wise, not flattened.

non_finite_attempt.description: Evidence from attempting to serialise a manifest with a NaN parameter: either {'raised': '<message>'} or {'bytes': '<what was written>'}. The runner judges; the adapter does not.
